payload.text: The Crown's case relies on E-001. Mira states: "I saw Fictional Rowan hand the sealed envelope to Fictional Ellis. I do not know what the envelope contained." The fictional condition the Crown must prove beyond a reasonable doubt is that Fictional Ellis received the sealed envelope from Fictional Rowan. E-001 attributes Mira's account only; it does not prove contents or guilt. The Crown acknowledges this limit and its burden. No further evidence is supplied at this stage.

Members of the jury, the Defence agrees with the Crown's acknowledgment of E-001's limits. Mira states she saw Fictional Rowan hand the sealed envelope to Fictional Ellis, but she does not know what it contained. The fictional condition is sealed-envelope receipt. E-001 attributes Mira's account only; it does not prove contents or any knowing-participation element, and no actual offence is defined. The Defence will hold the Crown to its burden on the supplied condition.
Which cash did Ellis knowingly receive in the sealed envelope? BAD_QUESTION_HEARING_321
